main_text.p: Plu.nom. Ion. ὑμέες, Doricé ὑμμες, Æolicé ὑμμες.
Dat. Poet. ὑμὶν, (ι correpto) Dor. ὔμμιν, Æol. ὑμμιν & ὑμμι.
Accuf.Ion. ὑμέας, Dor. ὑμμας, Æol. ὑμ-μας & ὔμμε.
3 Ος, ἓ fui, οἵ sibi, ἕ se. σφωέ & σφέ, σφωιν & σφίν.
σφῆς, σφῶν sui plurium, σφίσι, σφας.
Genit. Ion. ἓο, Poet. εἱο & ἕθεν, Dor. & Æol. ὦ, apud Cyprios Fío.
Accuf.Poet. ἕε. Dor. μὶν & νὶν: aliquanda etiam pluraliter.

page.notes: The Greek accents and breathings in this faded print are uncertain in places, especially in the Doric and Æolic forms; readings follow the scan as closely as possible. The Greek in lines 3 and 8 (ἓ, ἕ, ἴ, ἓο) may carry diacritics that the scan does not show clearly.
